title: Motion & Video v3 with shared provider-neutral refinement
decisions: Retain MiniMax H3 as ACCEPTED_CONDITIONAL_REFERENCE and OPTIONAL_DISABLED_BY_DEFAULT.
All FA3 applications consume shared Motion & Video Generation capability rather than direct H3 dependencies.
Add a separate shared Video Refinement contract behind Model Router and HRB.
Adopt NVlabs Sana SoL-Refiner generator/refiner lifecycle and refinement patterns only; do not import its runtime, weights or vendor kernels.
CPU reference execution remains mandatory at fabric level; CUDA, ROCm/HIP, Intel XPU and remote backends are optional admitted implementations.
No silent provider, model, refiner, device, backend or cloud fallback.
Runtime promotion requires physical Current Host positive, negative and rollback evidence.
